description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, verifying URL trust validation logic in various scenarios.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: A test suite class that validates the behavior of URL trust validation methods in CanvasActionTrust.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that the scaffold asset URL is recognized as trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Verifies that a matching trusted A2UI page URL is accepted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs from different origins are correctly rejected.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Checks that untrusted paths on a trusted origin are rejected.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Verifies that URLs differing only by fragment are accepted for trusted URLs.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Ensures URLs with mismatched query parameters are rejected.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Checks that descendant paths under trusted URLs are rejected when not explicitly trusted.
